verdict.rationale: Gram is an AI control plane and MCP gateway, so event-driven automation rules are a fair axis for it. The evidence only shows adjacent governance controls: risk policies that admins can 'manage', a 'Policy monitor' label, shadow MCP servers blocked by default, and budgets. None of these are documented as user-defined rules that trigger actions automatically on events, so they earn no credit as adjacent features.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
